يستهلكوا (form X)
# يَسْتَهْلِكُوا (yastahlikū) /jas.tah.li.kuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# يُسْتَهْلَكُوا (yustahlakū) /jus.tah.la.kuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
